## One formula, three distinct source obligations

Let `R>=3` (handle R=2 as finite base because Li_2 needs endpoint >=2), `X=R^2-1`, `t_c=floor(X/c)`, `Delta(t)=pi(t)-Li_2(t)`. PNT is already proved. The exact genuine-cofactor identity is

```text
N_R(c)=pi(t_c)-pi(R-1)            (1<=c<R)
L_R=sum_(c<R)mu(c)*(Li_2(t_c)-Li_2(R-1))
E_R=sum_(c<R)mu(c)*(Delta(t_c)-Delta(R-1))
S_R=sum_(n<=X,P+(n)<R)mu(n)
M(X)=S_R-L_R-E_R.
```

Do **not** treat the last equality as a bound. Its c=1 term contains `Delta(X)`, variable c near R creates very short intervals, and the error `E_R` may be coherent with M(X). Complete `S-L-E` signed compensation is the unknown arithmetic. PNT does not give RH-strength pointwise `Delta` or an all-root correlated Möbius transport bound. Preserve the prime `p=R` cutoff, c=3 versus c>=5 half-run ancestry, `mu(pc)` sign and distinct original positive VF composite charge, squareful restorations and all mixed owner terms.

Consumers: (A) full-prefix square-root Mertens -> RH via classical criterion; (B) original finite-C `Q_R=2M(R-1)-M(R^2-1)` with historical `K_R`; (C) native `pi-VF_can` direct first-bad #915 with original clipped source, history, NNS denominator and strictly lower contiguous child-run.
